rationale: The list was proposed by the author and checked against the text: the limits of perception and the question of how reality can be known (epistemology, perception), the dependence of our picture of the world on the human form (models of reality), and mathematics as a possible universal language that could reach other forms of consciousness (mathematics, consciousness). “epistemology”, “models of reality”, and “consciousness” already exist in the corpus with the same wording; “perception” and “mathematics” are new. All five remain retrieval labels, not ready-made concepts for the future Explore map.
